description_md:
## What You Get

- 3 ready-to-copy prompts built for n8n’s new Text-to-Workflow: Lead Qualification, Mock Calendly Webhook JSON, and Fireflies Transcript → Nurture Branching.

- Lead Qualification: Calendly → GoHighLevel with OpenAI + Perplexity enrichment (domain extraction, deep company research, reputation checks), CRM field logging, Outlook alerts, and explicit “reputable company” rules.

- Mock Data: A realistic Calendly booking webhook JSON payload to drop into a test node and validate your trigger end-to-end.

- Transcript Intelligence: Listen for Fireflies notes, auto-score prospect fit, and branch to a done-for-you nurture sequence when they’re not ideal.
Want my import-ready n8n workflow JSONs and extra variations? They live in my Early AI-dopters Community — join here: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
